image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: First-frame reference image. Formats: .jpg/.jpeg/.png; max 50MB; min 300px per side; aspect ratio within 1:2.5 to 2.5:1.

duration.description: The duration of this shot in seconds
duration.title: Duration

multi_prompt.title: Multi Prompt
multi_prompt.description: Multi-shot storyboard (1-6 shots). Each shot has its own prompt and duration; the total duration must not exceed 15s. Mutually exclusive with `prompt`.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Optional text prompt. For best results keep the prompt under 2500 characters. Mutually exclusive with `multi_prompt`.

enable_safety_checker.description: Disabling safety checks requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

file_name.title: File Name
